name: sparkx-delete-ai-group
description: Delete (archive) an AI managed group (托管组) itself - SD, SP, or SB - releasing its campaigns or migrating them to another group. Use when the user wants to delete / 删除 / 归档 a managed group (the group container) or wind one down. Destructive and irreversible. This archives the GROUP - it is NOT for removing a single campaign from a group (use sparkx-edit-ai-group), editing config (use sparkx-edit-ai-group), or creating a group (use sparkx-create-ai-group).
